import os,sys,time,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path[:0]=['script/supermimic_teleop','script/q1_five_stage','script/primebot_q1']
from common import ROOT,require,identity,save,now
from delivery import read
from paused_runtime import paused_state,own_gpu
from student_input_audit import resources
from student_cost import checked,charged,STAGES
p=ROOT/'data/supermimic_for_q1/Q1_LOW_LATENCY_CKPT32000_F0_HUMAN_CONDITIONING_PAIR01_20261108'
dest=p/'checkpoint_cpu_audit.json'
require(not dest.exists(),'Read the existing audit instead of repeating')
started=time.monotonic()
sample=resources(False)
config=read(ROOT/'script/q1_five_stage/conditional_shared_v04_20261104.json')
paused_state(config,read(ROOT/'logs/session_records/q1_shared_user_pause_20261106.json'))
r,g,f,a=[read(p/n) for n in ('result.json','fit.guard.json','fit_result.json','authorization.json')]
require(r['source_integrity']=='PASSED' and r['actual_optimizer_updates']==6000 and r['cost_settlement']['state']=='SETTLED','Wait for successful settled training')
require(g['status']=='WORKER_COMPLETED' and g['cleanup']['worker_reaped'] and g['cleanup']['worker_return_code']==0,'Wait for worker cleanup')
require(all(not Path('/proc',str(pid)).exists() for pid in [392055,392056,g['cleanup']['worker_pid'],54868,55672,55677,55678,55679]),'Task or old training still active')
with own_gpu():pass
import torch
from upper_mps_forecast import audit_cpu_tensors
torch.set_num_threads(1)
require(not torch.cuda.is_initialized(),'CPU audit initialized CUDA')
plan=read(ROOT/'script/supermimic_teleop/student_conditioning_plan_20261108.json')
base=read(plan['base_plan']['path'])
initial=base['initial_checkpoint']
require(identity(initial['path'])==initial,'Initial checkpoint changed')
b=torch.load(initial['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
audit_cpu_tensors(torch,b)
require(b['selected_update']==3000 and b['actual_adam_steps']==[3000]*4,'Wrong initial robot adapter')
records=[]
for arm in ('zero_human','real_human'):
 item=next(x for x in f['arms'] if x['variant']==arm)
 checkpoints=[]
 for name in ('selected.pt','last.pt'):
  path=p/arm/name
  c=torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
  count=audit_cpu_tensors(torch,c)
  require(c['schema']=='q1_f0_human_conditioned_residual_v1' and c['variant']==arm and c['actual_updates']==3000 and c['actual_adam_steps']==[3000]*8 and c['human_real_future_frames']==0,'Checkpoint metadata differs')
  require(set(c['base_encoder'])==set(b['base_encoder']) and all(torch.equal(v,b['base_encoder'][k]) for k,v in c['base_encoder'].items()),'Frozen human encoder changed')
  require(c['current_statistics']==b['current_statistics'] and all(c[k]==b[k] for k in ('base_encoder_sha256','decoder_sha256','frozen_teacher_policy_sha256')),'Statistics, teacher or decoder changed')
  require(c['provenance']['initial_student']==initial and c['provenance']['conditioning_plan']==identity(ROOT/'script/supermimic_teleop/student_conditioning_plan_20261108.json'),'Checkpoint provenance differs')
  require(set(c['adapter'])==set(b['adapter']) and set(c['human_adapter'])=={'0.weight','0.bias','2.weight','2.bias'},'Residual tensor keys differ')
  equal=all(torch.equal(v,b['adapter'][k]) for k,v in c['adapter'].items())
  zero=not bool(torch.count_nonzero(c['human_adapter']['2.weight'])) and not bool(torch.count_nonzero(c['human_adapter']['2.bias']))
  if name=='selected.pt':
   require(c['checkpoint_update']==item['selected_update'],'Selected update differs')
   unchanged=equal and zero
   require(unchanged==item['selected_policy_unchanged'],'Selected policy identity assertion differs')
   selected_equal=unchanged
  else:
   require(c['checkpoint_update']==3000,'Last checkpoint was truncated')
   steps=[int(x['step']) for x in c['optimizer']['state'].values()]
   require(steps==[3000]*8,'Actual saved Adam counters differ')
  checkpoints.append(dict(name=name,checkpoint=identity(path),cpu_finite_tensor_count=count,checkpoint_update=c['checkpoint_update'],robot_adapter_initial_equal=equal,human_output_layer_zero=zero))
 records.append(dict(variant=arm,selected_update=item['selected_update'],cpu_finite=True,initial_policy_equal=selected_equal,frozen_base_tensors_exact=len(b['base_encoder']),robot_adapter_tensors=4,human_adapter_tensors=4,current_statistics_exact=True,frozen_teacher_and_decoder_exact=True,checkpoints=checkpoints,prior_closed_loop_complete_cases_reused=0 if selected_equal else None,prior_closed_loop_cases_reused=7 if selected_equal else None,new_closed_loop_required=not selected_equal))
require(all(identity(x['path'])==x for x in a['protected_inputs']),'Protected inputs changed')
l=checked(read(ROOT/'logs/session_records/q1_low_latency_gpu_cost_20261107.json'))
require(charged(l)==5036 and not any(x['state']=='RESERVED' for x in l['runs']),'Cost settlement differs')
require(not torch.cuda.is_initialized(),'CPU checkpoint audit initialized CUDA')
record=dict(stage='F0_HUMAN_CONDITIONING_PAIR01_COMPLETED',status='PASSED',observed_utc=now(),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,result=r,guard=g,arms=records,initial_checkpoint=initial,protected_sources_unchanged=len(a['protected_inputs']),protected_authorization=identity(p/'authorization.json'),resources=resources(False),resource_before_cpu_audit=sample,task_and_original_training_processes_exited=True,gpu_lock_released=True,cost_ledger=dict(charged_seconds=charged(l),by_stage={s:charged(dict(l,runs=[x for x in l['runs'] if x['stage']==s])) for s in STAGES},outstanding_reservations=0),new_model_calls=0,new_optimizer_updates=0,new_physical_steps=0,new_rendered_frames=0,cuda_initialized=False,original_shared_training_resumed=False,user_accepted_checkpoint=None,policy_identity_proof='Frozen base/statistics/decoder and robot adapter equal initial; zero final human layer adds identically zero for all finite latent inputs')
save(dest,record)
save(ROOT/'logs/session_records/q1_human_conditioning_completed_20261108.json',record)
print('Q1HC_CPU_AUDIT',json.dumps(dict(status=record['status'],seconds=record['elapsed_seconds'],arms=records,protected=len(a['protected_inputs']),resources=record['resources'],cost=record['cost_ledger'])),flush=True)
